requirement_text: IELTS Academic: "Minimum overall score: 6.5", "Minimum score per section: 6.0". TOEFL iBT, tests before 21 January 2026: "Minimum overall score: 90", "Minimum score per section: 21"; tests from 21 January 2026 onward: "Minimum overall score: 4,5", "Minimum score per section: 4,5". "Test results must be no older than 2 years."
limitations: Exemptions exist, including completed Dutch VWO or an IB/EB diploma taught fully in English.
test_scale: IELTS Academic 0-9; TOEFL iBT on both the 0-120 and post-21-January-2026 banded scales

requirement_text: EMI-advanced level — IELTS Academic: overall band score 7.0, all components (Speaking, Listening, Reading, Writing) 6.5. TOEFL iBT (new scale): overall 100, all components 4.5. "IELTS Academic and TOEFL iBT (including Home Edition) cannot be more than 2 years old."
limitations: Utrecht names its levels by EMI tier (this page covers "EMI-advanced") rather than by a single university-wide score; which tier a given programme requires was not verified for every programme in this pass. A lower general tier also exists (found via search but not independently re-verified on its own official page in this pass, so not separately recorded).
researcher_notes: University College Roosevelt, one of Utrecht's honours colleges, separately requires IELTS 7.0 with no component below 6.5 per its own admission page — structurally the same numbers as this EMI-advanced tier but not confirmed to be the same policy; recorded here only for the main university's EMI-advanced tier.
test_scale: IELTS Academic 0-9; TOEFL iBT new banded scale

requirement_text: "Prospective students who graduated from a high school that is equivalent of Turkish schools (and eligible Turkish and TRNC students) can directly apply to OzU with the scores of OzU-YOS or an equivalent examination; or with the diploma scores." "Quotas for the program is announced by OSYM in the OSYS Higher Education Programs for International Students Guide every year."
researcher_notes: Content confirmed directly in the browser after expanding the page, not from a summary alone.

requirement_text: For English-medium programmes: newly enrolled students sit Phase 1 (English Placement Test) then, if they score "at least 60 out of 100", earn the right to sit Phase 2 (English Proficiency Examination, "TRACE"). "Students who score at least 65 out of 100 on the English Proficiency Examination begin their undergraduate diploma program." Students who do not reach 65 are placed in the English Preparatory Program. "The English Proficiency Examination result is valid for two years from the date the exam was taken."
scope: English-medium programmes — OzU's own placement/proficiency exams
limitations: This describes OzU's own internal exam route (taken after enrollment, at the start of the academic year), not an external TOEFL/IELTS submission requirement — the page does not state whether an external test score can substitute for TRACE, only that this internal two-phase process exists.
researcher_notes: Genuinely different in kind from every other English-requirement row in this batch: every UK/NL institution's requirement is met BEFORE enrollment via an external test; Özyeğin's is measured AFTER enrollment via its own two-phase internal exam. A student comparing "what score do I need" across institutions needs to know this is not the same kind of requirement, not just a different number.
test_scale: OzU Placement/Proficiency Exam 0-100 (institution-specific, not comparable to IELTS/TOEFL)

requirement_text: "Le domande di pre-iscrizione devono essere completate e inviate entro il 30 giugno 2026, ore 23:59 (ora italiana)" — pre-enrolment applications for non-EU students residing abroad requiring a study visa must be completed and submitted by 30 June 2026, 23:59 Italian time.
limitations: This is Sapienza's own deadline for the Universitaly pre-enrolment step, not a national deadline — other Italian universities set their own different Universitaly deadlines for the same 2026/2027 cycle (e.g. Pisa and Ca' Foscari were found to use 30 September 2026, per the same research pass, for those two institutions specifically), so it must not be generalized to other Italian universities in this dataset.
